Consider the group B = ⟨a, b | (bab−1 )a(bab−1 )−1 = a2 ⟩ introduced by
Baumslag in 1969. The same relation is satisfied by the functions f (x) = 2x and
g(x) = 2x under the operation of composition in the group of germs of monotonically
increasing to ∞ continuous functions on (0, ∞), where two functions are identified if
they coincide for all sufficiently large arguments. Is the representation a → f , b → g
of the group B faithful?                                              A. Yu. Olshanskii
  ∗ No, it is not (C.-F. Nyberg-Brodda, Preprint, 2026, https://arxiv.org/abs/
2606.27408).
